title: 第11章 千年的仇恨第12章 两败俱伤(上)
content_zh:
正文 第十一章千年的仇恨?????“黑环，今天你必须给我一个交代，让我可以回去交差，否则你今天就不用走了。”听到巨型蟒蛇不阴不阳的声音，黄金半兽人再也压不住自己心头的怒火道。?
“嘿，金蒙，给你面子，叫你一声金大哥，你不要得寸进尺，你以为你是谁啊。”巨型蟒蛇丝毫不给面子的说道。?
“好，呵呵，好今天我就斩下你的头颅，回去给我的族人。”黄金人听完巨型蟒蛇的话语，气急笑道。?
随即脸色一冷，右拳迅速伸出。叶宇轩立即看到随着黄金人拳头的伸出，一道犹金黄色气流凝聚形成的气拳飞射出去，速度之快直接破开空气，让叶宇轩的双眼完全无法捕捉。?
而巨型蟒蛇，犹如红灯笼般大小的眼睛忽然射出两到红色的光芒，迎上那一拳。?
“蹦。”惊天的爆炸声在两道能量碰撞之地响起，接着迅速向外扩散。一秒都不到的时间。这股强大的气流已经传到了叶宇轩的身旁。?
顿时一股头晕目眩的感觉涌上心头。五脏六腑受到这股强大起气流，气血上涌，身体里一阵难受。叶宇轩立即感受到喉咙中一阵难受，好像有什么要从中喷出。?
但是在如此危机的时刻，发出任何声音都将是致命的。强行忍住这一感觉。不知过了多久，终于压制住了。叶宇轩艰难的看着几十米玩的两个巨型怪物。双眼中充满了郁闷与无奈。更多的是多自己弱小的愤怒。?
“哈哈，金蒙啊，你就只会这一招吗？对我没用的。”巨型蟒蛇看见黄金兽人一击没有成效立即嘲笑道。?
没人理睬巨型蟒蛇的嘲笑。黄金兽人踏地的双脚猛力一蹬，犹如一颗炮弹一般，飞向巨型蟒蛇，只是身后留下飞扬的尘土。速度之快无法估计。?
看着黄金兽人的接近。巨型蟒蛇立即停止了笑容。毕竟相处和黄金兽人相处依旧的他知道，黄金兽人一族有个称号叫做：陆地近战无敌。?
虽然看上去自己的身体比他庞大，但是被其靠近后的后果是自己无法承受的。接着在叶宇轩睁的大大的双眼前，一个三米粗壮的黑色巨尾从远方的密林中飞出，目标正是飞在空中的黄金兽人。?
“砰。”没有防备到，巨型蟒蛇这一手的黄金兽人，被着带着巨力的尾巴飞甩出去。自己的身体连续撞倒将近10颗苍天古树才停下，抵消了这股冲击力。?
右手捂着自己的胸口缓缓站起了。突然在巨型蟒蛇和叶宇轩的眼中，黄金兽人一口鲜血从嘴中吐出。?
看着他的样子，就知道因为刚刚的失误，受了不小的伤害。?
双眼直直的看着巨型蟒蛇，黄金兽人艰难的缓缓道：“你的尾巴，是什么时候修复好的，我记得一千年前不是被我彻底打掉了吗？”?
“哈哈，你还记得打断过我的尾巴啊，原来你还记得，”听到黄金兽人的话语。巨型蟒蛇忽然大笑了起来，只是叶宇轩听着他的笑声，从中感受到了无尽的凄凉与痛苦。?
“你知道吗?一千年前就在我就要化蛇成龙的时候，遇到了你。因为你那极度好战的性格，硬要拉着我与你一战，就是那一战我的尾巴断了，让我成龙之梦破灭。?
从此以后我心中只有两个念头一：修复我的尾巴，再次向成龙拼搏，二：就是报仇，报仇，杀死你，你这个浪费我千年时间的家伙。巨型蟒蛇略带点疯狂的说道。?
“原来如此，原来如此，难怪你今天会一反常态杀死我族之人，就想我出现，杀死我？”知道了巨型蟒蛇仇恨的黄金兽人脑袋一动道。?

“是的，一切的一切都是为了你。好了，你全知道了，可以去死了。”说完，巨型蟒蛇双眼红光站次亮起，顿时两到犹如激光般的红色光芒，以迅雷不及掩耳的速度再次射向黄金兽人。”?
眼看就要击中受伤的黄金兽人了，突然，黄金兽人身体微微一侧躲过着凶险的一击。而在黄金兽人另外一般的叶宇轩立即看见，那两道红色的光芒一下穿过数百颗苍天大树。?
看到这光芒的破坏力，叶宇轩的额头不知不觉的滴下了汗水，想到，如果刚刚自己站在那一边，还有活命的机会吗？？?
感受到自己所在的位置也很是不安全的叶宇轩第一次没有了注意，不知道如果红光射向自己这边，自己该如果躲闪。看到那恐怖的毁灭能力，叶宇轩第一次发觉：在绝对的实力面前，任何阴谋诡计都是虚的，没有任何作用。?
也是来到这个世界上第一次真正对力量燃起了无限的渴望。当然如何提升获得实力这些都是后话，眼前的叶宇轩只能静静的看着两强争锋，暗暗祈祷自己能够幸运的躲避过此次灾难。?
“你，你，你没事，”看到黄金兽人轻易的躲避过自己的攻击。巨型蟒蛇带着怀疑惊讶的语气说道。?
“我，大陆上最强的黄金比蒙，兽人一族的王者，怎么会这么容易受伤，就凭你的尾巴，呵呵，你太高看自己了，一千年前的我可以打败你，现在的我也一样可以。”说话的同时，黄金比蒙身上散发出了无与伦比的惊天气息。那是强者的威势，那是强者的自信。?
感受道这股气息，自信满满的巨型蟒蛇首次变色。同时身上那强大的充满毁灭气息的威势也开展下来。双眼直视黄金比蒙，真正的认真对待起眼前这个千年的宿敌。?

Text Chapter 11: Thousands of Years of Hatred?????? "Black Ring, you must give me an explanation today so that I can go back to work, otherwise you don't have to leave today." Hearing the neither yin nor yang of the giant python, the golden orc could no longer suppress the anger in his heart. ?
"Hey, Jin Meng, I'll give you face, call you Brother Jin, don't push yourself too far, who do you think you are." The giant python said without giving any face. ?
"Okay, hehe, okay today I will cut off your head and give it back to my people." After hearing what the giant python said, the golden man laughed angrily. ?
Then his face turned cold and he quickly extended his right fist. Ye Yuxuan immediately saw that as the golden man stretched out his fist, an air fist formed by condensation of golden air flew out, breaking the air so fast that Ye Yuxuan's eyes could not catch it at all. ?
The giant python's eyes, which were as big as red lanterns, suddenly shot out two or three red rays of light and met the punch. ?
"Bounce." A shocking explosion sounded at the place where the two energies collided, and then quickly spread outward.一秒都不到的时间。 This powerful air flow has reached Ye Yuxuan's side. ?
Suddenly a dizzy feeling came over me. The internal organs were affected by this powerful flow of air, the blood surged up, and there was a feeling of discomfort in the body. Ye Yuxuan immediately felt a discomfort in his throat, as if something was about to spurt out. ?
But in a time of such crisis, making any noise would be fatal.强行忍住这一感觉。 I don't know how long it took, but I finally suppressed it. Ye Yuxuan looked at the two giant monsters dozens of meters away with difficulty. His eyes were full of depression and helplessness. It's more of anger at being weak. ?
"Haha, Jin Meng, is this the only trick you can do? It's useless to me." The giant python laughed immediately when he saw that the golden orc's attack was ineffective. ?
没人理睬巨型蟒蛇的嘲笑。 The golden orc's feet on the ground kicked hard, and like a cannonball, it flew towards the giant python, leaving only flying dust behind it.速度之快无法估计。 ?
看着黄金兽人的接近。 The giant python immediately stopped smiling. After all, he still gets along with the golden orcs, and he knows that the golden orcs have a title: invincible in close combat on land. ?
Although it seemed that her body was larger than his, the consequences of being approached by him were unbearable. Then, in front of Ye Yuxuan's wide-open eyes, a three-meter thick black giant tail flew out from the dense forest in the distance, targeting the golden orc flying in the air. ?
"Bang." Unexpectedly, the golden orc in the giant python's hand was thrown away by its tail with great power. His body knocked down nearly 10 ancient trees in the sky before stopping, which offset the impact. ?
右手捂着自己的胸口缓缓站起了。 Suddenly, in the eyes of the giant python and Ye Yuxuan, the golden orc spit out a mouthful of blood. ?
Looking at him, you could tell that he had been hurt a lot because of his mistake just now. ?
Looking straight at the giant python, the golden orc said slowly and with difficulty: "When was your tail repaired? I remember that it was completely knocked off by me a thousand years ago?"?
"Haha, you still remember breaking my tail, it turns out you still remember," I heard the golden orc's words. The giant python suddenly laughed, but Ye Yuxuan felt endless desolation and pain when he listened to his laughter. ?
"Did you know? I met you a thousand years ago just when I was about to transform into a snake and become a dragon. Because of your extremely bellicose personality, you forced me to fight with you. In that battle, my tail was broken and my dream of becoming a dragon was shattered.?
From then on, I only had two thoughts in my mind: one: repair my tail and fight against Jackie Chan again; two: revenge, revenge, kill you, you who wasted my thousand years.Guy. The giant python said slightly crazy. ?
"I see, that's it. No wonder you went out of your way to kill members of my clan today, just because you wanted me to show up and kill me?" The golden orc, who knew the hatred of the giant python, said with a twitch in his head. ?
"Yes, everything is for you. Okay, you know everything, you can go and die." After saying that, the giant python's eyes lit up with red light, and suddenly two laser-like red lights shot at the golden orc again at lightning speed. "?
Just as he was about to hit the injured golden orc, suddenly, the golden orc leaned slightly to one side to avoid the dangerous blow. Ye Yuxuan, who was another ordinary among the golden orcs, immediately saw the two red rays of light passing through hundreds of big trees in the sky. ?
Seeing the destructive power of this light, sweat dripped from Ye Yuxuan's forehead unconsciously. He thought, if he had been on that side just now, would he still have a chance to survive? ? ?
Feeling that his position was very unsafe, Ye Yuxuan lost his attention for the first time and didn't know how he should dodge if the red light shot towards him. Seeing the terrifying destructive power, Ye Yuxuan realized for the first time: in the face of absolute strength, any conspiracy and trick are empty and have no effect. ?
It was also the first time in this world that I truly ignited an infinite desire for power. Of course, how to improve and gain strength is a matter for later. Ye Yuxuan in front of him could only watch the two powers compete quietly, secretly praying that he could be lucky enough to avoid this disaster. ?
"You, you, you're okay," seeing the golden orc easily dodge his attack. The giant python said with a tone of suspicion and surprise. ?
"How could I, the strongest Golden Behemoth on the continent and the king of the orc clan, be injured so easily, just with your tail? Haha, you think too highly of yourself. I could defeat you a thousand years ago, and I can do the same now. "While speaking, Golden Behemoth exuded an unparalleled and shocking aura. That is the power of the strong, that is the confidence of the strong.?
Feeling this aura, the confident giant python changed color for the first time. At the same time, the powerful aura of destruction on his body also developed. Staring directly at Golden Behemoth, he truly took the thousand-year old enemy in front of him seriously. ?
